label: Protective process omission witnesses
paraphrase: A four-state, two-process, two-bearer model witnesses interruption of a two-edge destructive flame path and two-step guarded survival. Deleting its threat label or a threat to another bearer leaves the flame path destructive. Bypass and later replacement paths remain destructive after flame suppression. Omitting admissibility, loss coverage or initial existence defeats safety with other carrying conditions retained. Realized protective success coexists with an independently empty CausesIn relation. Stipulated finite histories only, not real conservation or metaphysical possibility.
